title: APIBinding
description: Binds a page to a relative HTTP endpoint (BE-02, SCRUM-20). endpointUrl must be environment-agnostic — relative path only, no host or scheme (T-13 / T-12).

name.description: Optional binding name (T-12 examples: listWorkOrders, createWorkOrder).

httpMethod.description: HTTP method (T-12). Closed to the four methods listed in the T-12 outline.

endpointUrl.description: Relative URL only, e.g. /api/v1/work-orders. Must start with /. No scheme or host (SCRUM-20 environment-agnostic rule).

headers.description: Header name to value or placeholder (T-12). Required; empty object is valid.

requestMapping.description: Maps UI/entity fields to request locations. Shape from the T-12 outline (path, query, body).

responseMapping.description: Maps API response paths to UI usage. Shape from the T-12 outline (item, list, pagination). Empty object is valid.

linkedComponentIds.description: Optional component UUIDs that consume this binding (T-12).
